parts.label: a
parts.text:
Adjust the position of the load attached to the metre rule so that its centre is 90.0 cm from
the pivot.

parts.text:
Displace the rule a small distance to one side and allow it to swing. Measure and record the
time t taken for 10 complete swings. A complete swing is shown in Fig. 2.1.
